title: Fire Mage Child Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a young Black girl with braided hair wearing orange and black armored clothing with skull motifs. She manipulates bright orange magical fire, creating an energy orb, holding a fiery sphere above her head, projecting a powerful flame beam, and standing confidently with residual sparks.
prompt: A young Black girl with intricate braids wearing detailed orange and black fantasy armor with skull decorations and leather straps, shown in four different dynamic poses against a dark teal background. In the first she holds a swirling orb of fire, in the second she raises a large glowing fireball above her head with both hands, in the third she casts a powerful beam of fire from her hands, and in the fourth she stands confidently with magical sparks around her. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
